subject: MedNova Coupa onboarding: field exceptions, PO prefix, and MSA sequencing
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@mednova.com>
To: avery.johnson@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@mednova.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Supplier onboarding questions + MSA redlines

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the demo last week — procurement wants to move forward but has a few operational questions before we start portal registration in Coupa. Our team is seeing some mismatches between required fields in Coupa and items called out in Redwood's standard MSA/order form. Specifics:

- PO number formatting: our ERP requires a prefix (we use "MNV-") and up to 16 characters. Will Redwood accept PO numbers with a prefix stored in the vendor record?
- EDI / PO format: we currently send X12 850. Is outbound EDI supported or should we rely on PDF invoices routed to an address?
- Remit-to / tax info: Coupa requires a supplier tax_id and remit address fields during registration. We expect these to map into Redwood's order form. Any required fields we should pre-fill?
- Sequence: procurement prefers that vendor registration in Coupa be completed before we execute the MSA so PO creation can happen immediately. Does Redwood insist on countersigned MSA before activating a vendor?
- Data retention and audit evidence: we will need SOC 2 evidence and a statement about logs/retention for invoice/audit purposes.

Attached is our Supplier Questionnaire (short). Can you confirm the right contact on Redwood's legal/ops side and the proposed sequencing so we can schedule our onboarding call?

Thanks,

Elena Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager | MedNova Health
elena.ruiz@mednova.com
procurement@mednova.com

Attachment: MedNova_Supplier_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@mednova.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding questions + MSA redlines

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Legal (Marissa) and Ops (Ben) so we can align on sequencing and required fields. Answers below and a proposed mutual action plan.

Quick answers:
- PO prefix: Yes, we can store a PO prefix (e.g., "MNV-") in our vendor profile and accept PO numbers with that prefix. We'll need the exact prefix string and any character limits; Coupa export will help.
- EDI: We support X12 850 intake and can map to your PO format, but EDI onboarding is a separate step (scheduling with our EDI team). As a fallback we accept PDF invoices by email.
- Remit/tax fields: Required for activation: supplier name, tax_id/VAT, remit_address, primary billing contact (name + email), and remit_email for invoice routing. If you have a Coupa export of field names we can map them.
- Sequencing (MSA vs registration): Our preference is a countersigned MSA before full production activation (billing/PO acceptance). However, we can provision a limited sandbox vendor record (test POs, no payable) prior to signature so your teams can validate mapping and EDI flows.
- SOC 2 / logs: We'll attach SOC 2 summary and a short note on log retention and invoice audit traces.

Proposed mutual action plan:
1) Legal redline review (Marissa) — target 3 business days for initial comment cycle.
2) MedNova returns completed Supplier Questionnaire + Coupa field export.
3) Redwood provisions sandbox vendor in Coupa for mapping/testing.
4) Finalize MSA redline and countersign.
5) Production vendor activation + PO acceptance.

Suggested dates: start legal review today (12 Jan), sandbox provision by 18 Jan, target production activation week of 25 Jan, contingent on redline turnaround. If that timeline looks tight we can stretch it.

Marissa — can you review the MSA redline request below and confirm which clauses are non-starters vs standard negotiation items? Ben — can you coordinate sandbox provisioning once we have the Coupa export?

Elena — happy to hop on a 30-minute call to walk through the mapping. What times on 13–15 Jan work for you?

Best,
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com
O: +1 415 555 0123

Attachment: (none)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: avery.johnson@redwood.com, elena.ruiz@mednova.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding questions + MSA redlines

On Tue, Jan 12, 2027 at 12:03 PM Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marissa — can you review the MSA redline request below and confirm which clauses are non-starters vs standard negotiation items?

Hi all — I reviewed the standard Redwood MSA against the comments Avery outlined. High-level guidance and redlines attached.

- Liability cap: Redwood's standard is liability capped at fees paid in the 12 months preceding the claim. MedNova has proposed unlimited liability for certain line items; that is a negotiation point. We can accept carve-outs for gross negligence or willful misconduct but not uncapped commercial liability.
- Data retention / logs: We can produce SOC 2 report and a log-export for invoice/audit traces. Our default retention for access logs is 90 days; for billing/usage records we retain 3 years. We can provide an addendum with extended retention for procurement audit if required (standard addendum with potential fees).
- PO acceptance: We require that the PO include the agreed PO number in the "po_number" field. If Coupa prepends a prefix (MNV-) we will accept it as long as the resulting field length is within 32 characters. Please confirm exact prefix.
- Export controls/subprocessors: We require listing of subprocessors; we can provide our subprocessor registry and a data processing addendum.

I've attached a redline (file: redwood_MSA_redline_mednova_20270113.docx) with comments. For timeline: if MedNova returns comments by EOD 14 Jan, we can do a single internal review and aim to provide final positions by 18 Jan.

Please note: production activation without a countersigned MSA is possible only with bilateral written approval from Procurement + Redwood Legal (sign-off recorded in the HubSpot deal). Sandbox/testing can proceed without signature.

Marissa Cole
Head of Contracts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_MSA_redline_mednova_20270113.docx (Word doc, redline comments)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@mednova.com>
To: avery.johnson@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, procurement@mednova.com
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding questions + MSA redlines

Thanks — appreciate the quick review. A few updates from procurement after internal check:

- Coupa export attached (Coupa_export_sample.csv) with the exact field names we use. PO prefix confirmed as "MNV-"; resulting PO numbers will be <= 16 characters total.
- Procurement is comfortable with Redwood's retention windows as long as we receive a written confirmation and SOC 2 report (we requested the SOC 2 summary via your security contact).
- Regarding liability cap: procurement is willing to accept Redwood's cap if we can get a reciprocal escrowing of a limited SLA credit for prolonged outages (we propose a 48-hour severity-1 credit). This is a commercial ask — can your team weigh in?
- EDI: procurement will begin EDI onboarding after sandbox tests; for now they will route PDFs to invoices@mednova.com while we finalize X12 mappings.

Next steps for us: we will return Coupa export mapping notes by EOD 21 Jan, and procurement is prepared to sign the MSA within 48 hours of final redline resolution. Can Redwood provide sandbox vendor credentials by 18 Jan so our integrations team can test?

Proposed call: 21 Jan 10:00 AM PT to walk mapping and sign-off checklist. Does that work for Redwood?

Regards,

Elena Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager | MedNova Health
